title: Attendance and the Size of an Insured Portal Booking — Appointment Series Questions Answered
content:
Training questions on how attendance on an Appointment Series sets the insured portal attendance limit.

**The rule.** The insured portal attendance limit is the maximum appointments in one booking of the series' format where the series shows at least 8 attended appointments, 6 appointments where it shows at least 4 but fewer than 8 attended appointments, and 4 appointments where it shows fewer than 4.

**Which attendances count?** Every attended appointment recorded on the series itself.

**What is the format's maximum appointments in one booking?** 12 for the Telehealth 30-Minute, Standard 45-Minute and Extended 60-Minute Visit Series; 8 for the Aquatic Therapy and Specialty One-on-One Visit Series; 18 for the Post-Operative Priority Visit Series.

**A Post-Operative Priority Visit Series shows exactly 8 attended appointments — what is the limit?** 18.

**With 7 attended appointments?** 6, as for 4, 5 or 6.

**With 3?** 4, as for none at all.
